sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Vintage Anti-Tarnish Silver Blue Dial Bracelet Watch
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Add timeless elegance to your everyday style with this Vintage Anti-Tarnish Silver Bracelet Watch, featuring a stunning deep blue round dial and an intricate chain-link bracelet design. With its jewellery-inspired vintage aesthetic, this watch effortlessly combines the charm of a classic timepiece with the beauty of a statement accessory.
The anti-tarnish finish helps maintain its elegant silver-tone appearance with proper care, while the rich blue dial adds a sophisticated touch to your look. Perfect for women who love unique, vintage-inspired accessories that stand out without being over the top.
Product Highlights
- ✨ Vintage-inspired jewellery watch design
- 💎 Anti-tarnish silver-tone finish
- 💙 Elegant deep blue round dial
- ⌚ Quartz movement
- 🔗 Detailed chain-link bracelet strap
- 🌸 Stylish combination of watch and jewellery
- 👗 Perfect for ethnic and western outfits
- 🎁 Great gifting option for girls and women
- ✨ Ideal for everyday wear, parties, outings & special occasions
Perfect For
College, office, casual outings, festive occasions, parties, date nights and gifting.
Care Tip: Keep away from perfumes, water, excessive sweat and harsh chemicals. Store in a dry place when not in use to help maintain the finish.
